title: Deshaun Watson beating Shedeur Sanders as Browns' Week 1 starter is just the beginning. Now, a tenuous reality awaits

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Deshaun Watson beating Shedeur Sanders as Browns' Week 1 starter is just the beginning. Now, a tenuous reality awaits
sources.description: Multiple sources with knowledge of the Browns' decision-making factors suggest: The decision to name Watson rather than Sanders did not arrive via a landslide. This was not a decision about who is "good" or "bad."
